metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: AI — Model Parameter Extraction via Database
properties.description: Detects attempts to extract model parameters through database queries used in AI pipeline
properties.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category == "SQLSecurityAuditEvents" | where statement_s contains "model" or action_name_s contains "parameter" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), database_name_s, session_server_principal_name_s | where count_ > 3 // AZ-AI-DB-013
